items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-05
items.q: I went up there many nights and played for hours or so before him let him sleep. Played drums for him.

ctx.x: He was getting all fine. Um, yesterday we were talking about Earl Foster and some of the guys that used to work with him. Who did you mention?

Yeah, well I said he was playing with, uh, Kaiser. Oh yeah, Kaiser used to be with him. Yeah, they was at, uh, Cornell and, uh, Burgundy. They had a night, uh, jitney dance, taxi dance up there, upstairs. And they worked there for quite a number of years. Poor Earl used to sing until he sing himself to sleep. He fell asleep while he was singing? He fell asleep while he was playing the drums. I went up there many nights and played for hours or so before him let him sleep. Played drums for him. Go downstairs in his…
Yeah, he was a smart guy.
